title: Margins dichotomy at global finite Ds optima (conditionally centered laws)
statement: For d_psi=1 and score laws with conditionally centered nuisance (E[S_lam|shat]=0: Gaussian, elliptical), atomless efficient-score marginal with a unique optimal scalar K-quantizer (log-concave suffices) and swap-rich nuisance conditionals, almost surely along exact global finite Ds optima: (i) the value converges to the unrestricted population supremum v_K over all measurable K-cell quantizers, attained only by the optimal efficient-score interval quantizer, which is fully nuisance-degenerate and DS9-infeasible; (ii) cell masses converge to the positive population masses - the mass margin (M2) is automatic and singleton cells die out (the N<=18 singleton evidence is pre-asymptotic); (iii) the binned nuisance and cross blocks vanish, so lambda_min(I_N) -> 0: the conditioning margin (M3) FAILS for every kappa>0 and every law in the class - the optimizer sheds binned nuisance information by design; (iv) the margin-compatible optimum v*(kappa) is strictly below v_K, so DS14 governs margin-certified (necessarily suboptimal by delta(kappa)>0) solutions, never free global optima, on this class; (v) DS11(a) efficient-score domination becomes an equality at optima. The (M5) projected-centroid object rides on a 0/0 slope and degenerates with the metric; the meaningful reduced geometry is the scalar J* geometry with distinct centroids.
assumptions: d_psi = 1 (general d_psi reduces to the open vector-D uniqueness/rigidity theory on the efficient score)
(L) conditional centering: E[S_lam | shat] = 0 a.s. (Gaussian, elliptical with finite second moments)
(S) atomless efficient-score marginal, positive density near the optimal boundaries, unique optimal scalar K-quantizer (log-concave suffices: Kieffer-1983, Graf-Luschgy-2000 Thm 5.1)
(R) swap richness: both nuisance signs available with bounded magnitude conditionally near the optimal boundaries (automatic for Gaussian)
E S = 0, E||S||^2 < oo, nonsingular full information; i.i.d. equal weights; exact empirical centering
global finite optima over feasible labelings (nonsingular binned nuisance block); K >= 3

proof_location.section: DS15. Margins dichotomy at global finite \(D_s\) optima

role: resolves OP28 for the conditionally centered class; redirects profiled-criterion compilation to the projected efficient-score rule
warning: Not yet independently audited. The (M3) failure is at FREE global optima: margin-certified exchange-stable labelings remain governed by DS14 at a quantified information cost delta(kappa) = v_K - v*(kappa) > 0. Class (L) and d_psi=1 only; the complement is OPEN-DS-MARGINS-NONCENTERED (OP29). Measured support: N-DS-MARGINS-TREND (fine-grid exact optima, sandwich verified exactly on every instance), N-DS-SCALAR-MASS, N-DS-MARGINS-EXACT-ANCHOR.
